title: Slide comments pptx 001
notes: python-pptx has NO comments API, so the comment layer is injected post-save by a zip rewrite: ppt/comments/authors1.xml (one p15:cavAuthor 'stichos-bot') and ppt/comments/comments1.xml (three p15:cmt entries, authorId=0, fixed dateTime 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, no wall-clock), plus the relationship chain from ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels (MS 2018/10 comments + commentsAuthors relationship types) and Content_Types overrides for both parts. This is the MINIMAL viable shape: synthetic parts modeled on PowerPoint's modern p15 cavAuthors/cmts layout — not validated against a schema, and the slide carries NO cmAuthorId/run-level anchors, so renderers may show nothing or drop the parts; tolerance varies by consumer and is part of what the fixture probes. Comment texts are part of the reference text.
